title: Dip Peking duck skin in sugar — the finale | Beijing, Walked EP5 | China Travel Expert
description:
Every Beijing route ends the same way: Peking duck.

Real footage from Siji Minfu, Beijing: the open kitchen, chefs at work, lanterns and carved wood while you wait. EP5 closes the Beijing, Walked route — the full route lives on the channel page.

🧭 Expert Tip: dip the crispy duck skin in white sugar — that's the local way.
